rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is genuinely or truly the case.

example.english: The milk tea at this cha chaan teng is genuinely good.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲奶茶真係好飲。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 naai5 caa4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jam2

rows.note: Use this when genuinely means sincerely or from the heart, especially with feelings, intentions, or attitudes.

example.english: I genuinely appreciate all the help you’ve given me.
example.traditional: 我真心多謝你一路咁幫我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 sam1 do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 lou6 gam3 bong1 ngo5
